answer: Require proof of physical coverage. Each agent must anchor its identity to a real sensor, and every epoch random neighbors witness its radio beacons, checking that signal strength and timing fit the claimed spot, say a weather station among juniper scrub on a basalt plateau. A farm of three hundred clones on one rooftop can't fake three hundred positions: witnesses hear them all from one place, and any witness colluding with the farm is cross-checked by others farther out.
